_comment: v410 remembered_story: the ages a first-person memory dated only by a life-stage phrase may open and close at. earliest_memory_age is the owner's earliest-memory age (a 4th birthday by default); a vault overrides it with `earliest_memory_age: <n>` in profile.yaml or config.yaml. A band's low of null means 'the earliest-memory age'. Ages are whole years, both ends inclusive (12 = up to the 13th birthday). Read and validated by system/remembered_story.py; tests/test_v410_remembered_story_floor.py pins the defaults.
